desc: uses the wall clock: an NTP step or a manual clock change makes elapsed negative (tokens drain) or huge (full burst); needs time.monotonic()
check-then-set on the shared dict without a lock: concurrent first calls for a key create two buckets, so the key gets double the allowance
docstring promises 1 + retries attempts, the loop makes only `retries` (and sleeps after the final failure)
after the last failure it returns None instead of re-raising, so callers treat a failure as a None result
